<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Ink icons</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="icons.css">
<style>
:root{--paper:#f3f0e8;--ink:#1d1a16;--accent:#b4532a;--rule:rgba(29,26,22,.22);--fg:var(--ink);--bg:var(--paper);--ic-2:var(--bg)}
[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#16181c;--fg:#ece6d8;--rule:rgba(236,230,216,.22);--ic-2:var(--bg)}
[data-theme=accent]{--bg:#b4532a;--fg:#f3ead9;--rule:rgba(243,234,217,.32);--ic-2:var(--bg)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:15px/1.45 "Newsreader","Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;transition:background .3s,color .3s}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:.5px solid var(--rule);padding:14px 20px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 22px;align-items:center}
h1{font-weight:400;font-size:26px;margin:0 8px 0 0;letter-spacing:.01em;font-style:italic}
label,button,input{font:12px/1 "Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:inherit}
input[type=search]{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--fg);padding:6px 2px;width:150px;outline:none;text-transform:none;font-size:14px}
input[type=search]:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.seg{display:flex;gap:0;border:.5px solid var(--fg)}
.seg button{background:none;border:0;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--accent);width:130px}
main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(112px,1fr));gap:0;padding:12px 20px 80px}
.cell{border:0;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 6px 12px;text-align:center;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--rule);border-right:.5px solid var(--rule);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:96px;justify-content:center}
.cell:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fg) 6%,transparent)}
.cell:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-3px}
.cell .ic{--ic-size:var(--size,48px)}
.cell span{font:11px "Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.65}
.row{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:20px;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--rule);flex-wrap:wrap}
.row .ic{--ic-size:var(--s)}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:20px;transform:translate(-50%,30px);background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;font:12px "Inter Tight",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.05em;opacity:0;transition:.25s;pointer-events:none;max-width:90vw;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.none{padding:40px 20px;opacity:.6;font-style:italic;grid-column:1/-1}
.sr{position:absolute;left:-9999px}
</style></head><body>
